portInfo.description: Geiranger Port, run by Stranda Hamnevesen KF, sits deep in the UNESCO-listed Geirangerfjord with a dedicated cruise terminal concept built around the SeaWalk floating walkway, three anchorage positions, and a small fixed quay. The SeaWalk is published at 236 m long and 4.5 m wide, with >4,000 passengers/hour capacity and ADA compliance. The 2026 facilities PDF states the fixed Geiranger pier (49 m / 4.3–9 m draft) is not available for cruise ships (cargo only) and that passenger vessels should use the SeaWalk when available; on single-ship days ships ≥180 m are allocated to SeaWalk. Tender pier to centre is ~100 m / about five minutes. Stern-to at Lausneset max LOA 250 m; sway position 3S max 180 m.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Fjord viewpoints / Flydalsjuvet area — coach; ~120 min planning block.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask ship whether you are on SeaWalk or tender from anchorage — changes queues.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: SeaWalk/tender pier into village (~5 min). Coach to viewpoints common — times vary.
